description.en:
Booster T2 is a humanoid development platform for embodied-intelligence research and general robotics applications. The manufacturer lists a body approximately 140 cm tall and 42 kg, with 31 degrees of freedom distributed across the legs, seven-axis arms, waist and head. This layout supports coordinated whole-body movement and manipulation experiments.

Education and professional configurations differ in their computing hardware, with the professional option using NVIDIA Jetson Thor. Stereo vision and additional camera, lidar and hand options support different research requirements. Booster also publishes motion and payload figures with operating conditions; for example, the stated dual-arm load depends on posture. The open development tools allow teams to build and evaluate their own policies.
